battle.name: 狼尾灘之戰
battle.brief: 開皇八年冬，隋文帝分道伐陳，晉王楊廣領東路軍自採石濟江，首戰撞上陳將蕭摩訶據守的狼尾灘。陳軍乘夜襲營，隋軍一度崩潰，經賀若弼力諫才反敗為勝。此役是隋滅陳的開端；卡面羅馬短劍代表同代短兵刺擊的技術，隋軍岸戰用的環首刀與之同源，而左右戰局的仍是水戰紀律與火把照明的夜襲節奏。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 開皇八年冬，隋文帝楊堅以晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，總兵分八道南下，東路軍自採石濟江，楊素另率一軍溯長江上取江陵，韓擒虎率精兵趨廬州，賀若弼、高熲佐楊廣節制東路，蘇綽掌戶部度支以供軍食。隋朝此時已統一北方，府兵與宿衛並立，舟師器械、攻城具與糧秣均預先籌備，志在直取建康。陳朝則倚長江天險自守，陳後主陳叔寶坐鎮建康，以武平太守蕭摩訶為江防主將，戎暉率青龍戰船百餘艘屯狼尾灘，另有重兵分守京口、採石與上游要隘。陳軍以樓船、蒙衝成列，倚岸結陣，靠弩箭與沿岸火炬照明而拒客軍；朝廷內部則將帥分權、令出多門，前線無法統一調度。兩軍交戰形態因此極不對稱：隋為渡江攻勢，陳為岸防守勢，狼尾灘一役實為隋軍首次登岸遇上陳軍夜襲反制，攻守之勢在數日之間兩度翻轉。
countriesEn: In the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang, Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, put the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, in command as supreme commander of a campaign split into eight columns, each moving south. The eastern column crossed the Yangtze at Caishi; Yang Su was given a separate force to move up the river toward Jiangling; Han Qinhu led picked troops against Luzhou; He Ruobi and Gao Jiong assisted Yang Guang in directing the eastern army; and Su Cuo, who held the household and the grain accounts, made sure the army was fed. By this point the Sui had unified the north. Militia and palace guards stood side by side, and warships, siege gear and provisions had all been prepared beforehand, with the object of striking straight at Jiankang. The Chen, by contrast, relied on the Yangtze as a natural barrier. The Chen ruler, Chen Shubao, sat in Jiankang with Xiao Mohe, Administrator of Wuping, as the chief of the river defence; Rong Hui commanded more than a hundred Azure Dragon warships moored off Langbi; and other contingents held Jingkou, Caishi and the key points upstream. Chen troops formed up in tall towerships and armoured rams, took position along the bank, and met the invaders with crossbows and with torches lighting the shore. Inside the court, command was divided between jealous generals, orders came from several directions at once, and the front line could not be coordinated. The two sides therefore met in a very lopsided way: the Sui on the offensive, crossing the river; the Chen on the defensive, holding the bank. The battle of Langbi was in truth the first landing of the Sui army met by a Chen counter-stroke at night, and within a few days the balance of attack and defence turned over twice.
people: 楊廣以行軍元帥總領東路，開皇八年冬天時年未三十，狼尾灘中夜遭陳軍偷營，軍中惶恐、諸將失色，幸得賀若弼力諫才下令悉眾出擊，把敗勢扭轉。賀若弼為撫陽將軍，長於用兵，其後在開皇九年率軍夜渡京口、追奔建康，與韓擒虎會師於城下，陳後主自景寧殿井中被執，陳朝覆亡。高熲為楊廣長史，出謀劃策最為深密，是東路軍的樞紐。陳方主將蕭摩訶字元胤，蘭陵人，少以驍勇聞名，夜襲隋營一舉成功，兵敗退保建康，陳亡後隨主降隋，得授開府儀同三司，晚年卻捲入漢王楊諒兵變，仁壽四年為楊素所擒殺。戎暉守狼尾灘，其別隊為楊素部將王長史所擊潰，部眾盡為所俘。陳後主則一味宴遊，屢拒蕭摩訶出戰之請，勝負之機盡失於此。
peopleEn: Yang Guang led the eastern column as supreme commander; in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang he was not yet thirty, and when Xiao Mohe's men raided his camp by night the whole army was in confusion and the generals lost their colour. Only because He Ruobi pressed hard was an order given that all troops come out and fight, and the defeat was reversed. He Ruobi, who held the rank of General of Fuyang, was skilled in the use of troops; in the following year he led men across the Yangtze at Jingkou by night, pursued the Chen to Jiankang, and joined Han Qinhu below the city walls, where Chen Shubao was taken from the well of the Jingning Hall and the Chen was destroyed. Gao Jiong served as Yang Guang's chief councillor, planned more deeply than anyone else, and was the pivot of the eastern army. The Chen commander-in-chief was Xiao Mohe, courtesy name Yuanyin, a man of Lanling who had been famous for valour since youth. His night attack on the Sui camp succeeded at first, but after the defeat he withdrew to Jiankang; when the Chen fell he surrendered with his master and was granted the rank of Opening of the Three Departments, only to be drawn at the end of his life into the rebellion of the Prince of Han, Yang Liang, and to be captured and executed by Yang Su in 604. Rong Hui held Langbi, and his separate detachment was smashed by Wang Changshi, an officer of Yang Su, who took all his men prisoner. The Chen ruler, meanwhile, gave himself up to feasting and repeatedly refused Xiao Mohe's request to attack, and the decisive moment was lost in that refusal.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬短劍是本戰役的技術對照物。gladius 出現於羅馬共和國末期，約西元前100年前後定型：雙刃、葉形尖，劍身狹長約五十至六十公分，帶護手與柄頭，通體近一公斤，重心偏前，用途不是揮砍而是刺突，必須貼在大盾（scutum）弧面之內出手，並以盾緣磕擊、勾拉敵人兵刃，通常在標槍（pila）耗盡之後充作最後手段。晚期的東羅馬與拜占庭軍隊仍沿用此類短劍，直到西元500年前後才逐步被長劍（spatha）取代，故它與588年的戰場在時間上重疊。但狼尾灘沒有羅馬人：隋軍岸戰所用者是環首刀、匕首、長矛與鐵鎬，陳軍則以弩箭、長槊與沿岸火炬配合舟船，雙方近身相接的短兵，就是環首刀這一類的短刀。漢晉以來出土於中原與河西的三角柄環首刀，學界多認為與中亞、羅馬一系的短刀傳統有相通之處；本卡以羅馬短劍標示的，正是這種短兵相接以刺突與盾緣動作為核心的技術取向。
kitsEn: The Roman short sword on the card is a technical reference point for this battle, not a weapon that stood on the ground at Langbi. The gladius appeared in the late Roman Republic and was fixed in form around 100 BC: double edged, with a leaf-shaped point, a blade some fifty to sixty centimetres long, a guard and a pommel, the whole weapon close to a kilogram in weight and balanced forward. It was not swung but thrust. The blow had to be delivered from inside the curve of the large shield, and the shield rim was used to strike, to hook and to pull aside the enemy's blade, the sword normally serving as the last resort once the throwing javelins were spent. Late Eastern Roman and Byzantine troops still carried short swords of this kind, and they were only gradually displaced by the longer spatha around the year 500, so the weapon overlaps in time with the fighting of 588. There were, however, no Romans at Langbi. The Sui fought ashore with ring-pommel sabres, daggers, long spears and iron picks, while the Chen matched them with crossbows, long shafts and the torches that lit the bank for their fleets, and the short blade used at close quarters on both sides was the ring-pommel sabre. The triangular-hilted ring-pommel sabres excavated in the Central Plains and the Hexi Corridor from the Han and Jin periods onwards are generally held by scholars to share something with the short-sword tradition of Central Asia and Rome. What the card marks with the Roman short sword is precisely this orientation of close combat, in which the thrust and the movement of the shield rim are the core of the business.
tactics: 隋軍的戰法是先舟後陸：以舟師自採石渡江，銳士登岸即搶灘頭築營寨，步騎結陣自守，等候後續主力與糧船抵達；陳軍則倚南岸險固壘，以舟隊封江、弓弩壓灘，等隋軍立足未穩再行反擊。蕭摩訶在十二月的夜裡集中精兵，循岸以火炬照明，趁隋軍疲病不整偷營得手，隋軍中軍被突破，諸營驚潰，陳軍一路追至隋軍大營。賀若弼力主不可退而宜全軍出擊，隋軍才反敗為勝，乘勝追擊，陳軍大潰。得勢之後，隋軍據姑孰、扼採石與京口，遙制建康兩岸，把渡江點變成攻城基地；水戰受挫的教訓亦被記取，隋軍此後以蒙衝撞陳舟、以大型樓艦壓住江面，楊素更沿江陵一路策應，使陳朝南北兩線同時受兵。火炬與旗鼓的運用、舟師與步騎的銜接、夜間警戒與哨騎的配置，決定了那一夜誰先看見對方。
tacticsEn: The Sui method was boats first and soldiers after. The flotilla crossed at Caishi, the picked men landed, seized the head of the sandbank at once and dug in, and infantry and cavalry formed up to hold what they had while the main body and the grain boats came up. The Chen, holding the steep southern bank, massed ships to seal the river and kept crossbows over the landing place, waiting for the Sui to be unready before striking back. In the night of the twelfth month Xiao Mohe concentrated his best men, moved along the bank with torches to light the way, and took the Sui camp while it was tired and sick; the Sui centre was broken through, the camps panicked, and the Chen drove on to the Sui main camp. He Ruobi argued that the army could not fall back but must come out and fight, and only then did the Sui turn the tide and pursue, scattering the Chen. With the advantage in hand the Sui took Guushu and held Caishi and Jingkou, controlling both banks opposite Jiankang and turning a crossing place into a base for the siege. The lesson of the failed water fighting was taken as well: the Sui afterwards used armoured rams against Chen hulls and pressed on the river with large multi-decked warships, while Yang Su cooperated by moving upriver toward Jiangling, so that the Chen came under pressure on two fronts at once. The use of torches, drums and flags, the joining of the fleets with the troops on shore, the night watch and the posting of outriders decided which side would see the other first that night.
data: 兵力方面，史料差異極大。《資治通鑑》記開皇八年十一月隋主遣將伐陳，晉王廣為行軍元帥，總兵五十一萬八千人、分八道進兵；《隋書》則記楊廣所領東路軍為五萬一千人，自採石濟江。兩說都把後勤與預備兵一併計入，實際作戰與首批渡江之數應遠少於此。陳方在狼尾灘的舟兵，戎暉部有青龍戰船百餘艘、戰士數千；蕭摩訶夜襲所遣為精兵千許，各書所載或作數百。戰果方面，《資治通鑑》稱陳軍死者數萬，隋軍折損亦重，但沒有留下可核的明細。時間線是：開皇八年十月下詔、十一月分道出發並集結，十二月戰於狼尾灘；開皇九年正月楊素取江陵，隋軍入建康。距離上，狼尾灘在建康上游約二百里，隋軍自採石順流而下不過一日水路；江面寬度隨季節與河道變遷，古今測量相差甚遠，因此不宜以今尺換算當時舟船的吃水與載員。
dataEn: On numbers, the records differ sharply. The Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance records that in the eleventh month of the eighth year of Kaihuang the Sui ruler sent his generals against the Chen, put Prince Yang Guang in command of a total of 518,000 men, and advanced in eight columns; the History of Sui gives 51,100 men for the eastern column under Yang Guang, crossing at Caishi. Both figures fold logistics and reserves into the count, and the men actually fighting, and the first troops across, must have been far fewer. On the Chen side at Langbi, Rong Hui's force had more than a hundred Azure Dragon warships and several thousand soldiers; the picked men Xiao Mohe sent across on that night numbered around a thousand, though some books give only several hundred. As for the result, the Comprehensive Mirror speaks of tens of thousands of Chen dead and heavy Sui losses as well, but leaves no detail that can be checked. The timeline runs: the order was given in the tenth month of Kaihuang 8, the columns set out and assembled in the eleventh, and the battle at Langbi was fought in the twelfth; in the first month of Kaihuang 9 Yang Su took Jiangling and the Sui entered Jiankang. As for distance, Langbi lies about two hundred li upstream of Jiankang, a single day's easy run down the river from Caishi. The width of the river varied with the season and with the shifting channel, and measurements of old and modern days differ widely, so it would be unwise to convert them into the draught and the carrying capacity of the ships of the time.
cause: 隋與陳的對峙，源於南北分裂的尾巴。隋文帝開皇年間已平定北齊、統一北方，倉廩殷實，府兵與糧秣調度有餘；陳朝則偏安江左，土地日狹、賦役繁重，北境流民與豪族多持觀望之態，朝廷內部又有宗室與大臣的權力傾軋。開皇八年，隋文帝決定利用陳的內部空虛，舉國南征：以晉王楊廣統兵東路，取採石、姑孰、逼近建康，楊素、韓擒虎等分道策應，意圖一次滅陳、把南北分裂收束。陳後主對形勢的判斷則完全相反，他自恃長江天險，把防守寄托在舟師與上游要塞之上，屢次拒絕蕭摩訶主張的出擊與堅守之策，認定隋軍必待寒冬過去才會動作。於是隋軍選擇隆冬十二月的時機發動，雙方都錯判了對方的決心與準備程度，衝突便在狼尾灘這樣一個灘頭地帶先行爆開。
causeEn: The confrontation between Sui and Chen was the last tail of the division between north and south. Under the Kaihuang era the Sui had already destroyed Northern Qi and unified the north; the granaries were full and the militia and the grain system could shift supplies at will. The Chen, hugging the southeast, saw its territory shrink day by day and its taxes and corvee grow heavier; refugees from the north and the great clans sat on the fence, and inside the court princes and ministers were torn by a struggle for power. In the eighth year of Kaihuang the Sui ruler decided to exploit the emptiness inside the Chen and to invade the south with the whole country. Yang Guang was given the eastern column, to take Caishi and Guushu and close on Jiankang, with Yang Su, Han Qinhu and others operating in parallel, the intention being to destroy the Chen in a single stroke and to close the division between north and south. The Chen ruler judged the situation in exactly the opposite way. Confident in the natural barrier of the Yangtze, he rested the defence on his fleet and on the strong points upstream, and refused again and again the counsels of Xiao Mohe to attack or to hold fast, convinced that the Sui would not move until the cold had passed. The Sui therefore chose to strike in the depth of the twelfth month, and each side misjudged the resolve and the preparation of the other. The clash opened first on a sandbank such as Langbi.
impact: 狼尾灘一役是隋滅陳的序幕，也是南北朝最後一場大規模會戰的起點。此戰之後，隋軍在長江南岸站穩腳跟，取得姑孰、採石兩處渡口與江防的主動權，陳軍精銳折損、士氣崩潰，蕭摩訶雖仍是一時名將，卻已無兵可用。開皇八年十二月，楊素乘勝溯江西上，荊州與江陵相繼淪陷，陳的門戶洞開；開皇九年正月，韓擒虎自廬州疾馳建康，賀若弼渡京口直抵城下，陳後主被俘，陳朝覆亡，南北分裂至此結束，中國重歸一統，隨後的開皇之治把隋的制度推向極盛。但這場統一大業的代價也在隨後顯現：隋朝連年用兵、營運江南、興修運河又三征高句麗，國力迅速耗盡，仁壽末年已埋伏下二世而亡的危機，而唐人承繼的正是隋留下的這套制度與南北一統的版圖。就兵器史而言，狼尾灘的意義還在於它是一次典型的水陸銜接戰：短兵刺擊的技術在環首刀上延續，而在五百多年後的歐洲，羅馬短劍本身也正被長劍逐步取代，兩個文明在同一世紀裡各自走向新的兵刃形態。
impactEn: The battle of Langbi was the overture of the Sui conquest of Chen and the opening of the last large set-piece war between north and south. After it the Sui stood firm on the southern bank, took the crossings at Guushu and Caishi, and gained the initiative on the river; the picked troops of the Chen were broken and their morale shattered, and Xiao Mohe, still a famous commander in his own right, had no soldiers left to use. In the twelfth month of Kaihuang 8 Yang Su moved up the river and took Jingzhou and Jiangling in turn, opening the Chen's gates; in the first month of Kaihuang 9 Han Qinhu raced from Luzhou to Jiankang while He Ruobi crossed at Jingkou and came straight up to the walls. The Chen ruler was taken prisoner, the Chen was destroyed, the division between north and south came to an end, and China was whole again, with the Kaihuang prosperity carrying the Sui institutions to their height. The cost of that unification soon showed itself as well. The Sui campaigned year after year, garrisoned the south, cut the Grand Canal and made three invasions of Goguryeo, and drained the state so quickly that the crisis leading to the dynasty's early death was already visible in the last years of Renshou. What the Tang inherited was precisely this Sui system and this unified map. In the history of weapons, Langbi also matters as a typical joining of water and land fighting: the technique of thrusting at close quarters lived on in the ring-pommel sabre, while in Europe more than five centuries later the Roman short sword itself was giving way to the longer sword, two civilizations in the same century each moving toward new forms of blade.
result: 結果是隋軍的完全逆轉獲勝。蕭摩訶的夜襲雖然摧毀隋軍前陣、追至隋軍大營，卻因隋軍沒有就此崩潰，加上賀若弼與高熲力主反擊而功敗垂成，陳軍在狼尾灘被擊潰，死者數萬，蕭摩訶收攏殘兵退守建康，戎暉的別隊亦為楊素所遣王長史擊敗、所部盡為所俘。隋軍乘勝占據姑孰與採石，與京口、建康隔江相望，渡江不再是難事。開皇九年正月，隋軍取京口、下建康，陳後主陳叔寶被俘，陳朝正式滅亡；蕭摩訶降隋後受授開府儀同三司，隨陳後主入長安，隋文帝賞其武勇、授官不疑，卻未料他晚年站在漢王楊諒一邊，仁壽四年兵變失敗被楊素擒殺。一場以灘頭夜襲開端的戰役，最終牽動了兩個王朝的更替：陳亡隋立，南北統一，而隋朝短祿的開端也在同一條長江的戰線上悄悄顯現。
resultEn: The result was a complete Sui reversal. Xiao Mohe's night attack did break the Sui front and carry to the Sui main camp, but because the Sui did not dissolve on the spot, and because He Ruobi and Gao Jiong pressed for a counter-stroke, the Chen offensive came to nothing. The Chen army was shattered at Langbi with tens of thousands dead; Xiao Mohe gathered what was left of his men and fell back on Jiankang; and Rong Hui's separate detachment was beaten by Wang Changshi, sent by Yang Su, who took all of its men prisoner. The Sui occupied Guushu and Caishi, looking across the water at Jingkou and Jiankang, and crossing the river was no longer a difficulty. In the first month of Kaihuang 9 the Sui took Jingkou and entered Jiankang, the Chen ruler Chen Shubao was captured, and the Chen was formally destroyed. Xiao Mohe surrendered, was granted the rank of Opening of the Three Departments and followed Chen Shubao to the Sui capital; the Sui ruler admired his valour and appointed him without hesitation, not foreseeing that the old man would later stand on the side of the Prince of Han, Yang Liang, and be captured and killed by Yang Su when that rebellion failed in 604. A battle that opened with a night raid on a sandbank had pulled the succession of two dynasties in its wake: the Chen perished, the Sui rose, north and south were joined, and on the same river line the first hints of the short life of the Sui quietly appeared.
